`voice-command.wav` is synthetic speech generated offline with Windows
SpeechSynthesizer, not a recording of a person. It says: "I spent one real
on a microphone test this month." It contains no actual financial data.

This small fixture is for an explicitly authorized, one-request deployment
smoke test. The automated test suite uses a stub provider and incurs no
Gemini charges. Fixtures are not exposed by the static web server.
